exposure: Maternal hyperglycemic disorders (gestational diabetes mellitus, pre-existing diabetes)
Maternal hypertensive disorders (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia or eclampsia, pre-existing hypertension)
cohort: The study included 110,447 Louisiana Medicaid pregnant women experiencing their first-time delivery between January 1, 2016, and December 31, 2021.
finding: Maternal hyperglycemic and hypertensive disorders during pregnancy were associated with higher risks of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, and these associations largely persisted regardless of the COVID-19 pandemic period.
mod_finding: Maternal hyperglycemic and hypertensive disorders were associated with a higher risk of primary cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight, macrosomia, large for gestational age, small for gestational age
gest_age: Preterm birth, large for gestational age (LGA), small for gestational age (SGA)
